task: Find a news article on BBC News about the impact of the recent tech industry layoffs on the global economy. Summarize the key points and the name of the author, and provide the date of publication.
answer: Article: 'The ripple effects of layoffs' (on-page headline: 'The toll of layoff anxiety'), BBC Worklife, https://www.bbc.com/worklife/article/20230203-stress-anxiety-global-layoffs. Author: Josie Cox. Published: 6 February 2023 (2023-02-06T21:08:49.000Z). Key points: (1) Workers worldwide are experiencing severe anxiety and dread about being next to lose their jobs as layoffs sweep across industries, especially tech, where companies cut more than 150,000 workers in 2022 according to tracking sites. (2) Experts say this layoff wave is notable for its scope and scale because it comes even as underlying economic fundamentals improve - unlike the Great Recession, when US unemployment peaked at 10% with ~15 million unemployed; today the US rate is around 3.5%. (3) The cuts clash with the employee-centric, wellbeing-focused leadership championed during the pandemic, creating cognitive dissonance and eroding trust among both laid-off and remaining employees. (4) Experts warn that continued waves of layoffs - or even the looming threat of them - could deteriorate organisational cultures, with grim ripple effects on employee engagement, productivity and the wider economy. (5) There is an immediate human toll: research shows being laid off increases the risk of a host of health conditions, and the uncertainty itself harms workers' wellbeing.
